title: Countability of a type
statement: Fix universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. For a type $X$, the proposition $\operatorname{Countable}(X)$ means that there exists an injective map $X\to\mathbf N$ (equivalently, $X$ admits an injection into the natural numbers).

source.place: the Countable class declaration, lines 40–43, and its generated characterization countable_iff_exists_injective
